conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Cannot see, automatically fails sight-dependent checks, attacks with disadvantage, and is attacked with advantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Cannot attack or harm the charmer, who gains advantage on social checks involving the creature.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: Cannot hear and automatically fails checks that depend on hearing.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Suffers cumulative penalties according to its current level of exhaustion.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Has disadvantage on checks and attacks while the source is visible and cannot willingly move closer to it.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Its speed becomes 0 until the grapple ends.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Cannot be seen without special senses; its attacks have advantage and attacks against it have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Is incapacitated, cannot move or speak, automatically fails certain saves, and is especially vulnerable to nearby attackers.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Is transformed into an inanimate substance, incapacitated, resistant to damage, and largely insulated from outside effects.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Can only crawl until it stands and has altered attack advantages based on an attacker's distance.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Its speed becomes 0; its attacks and Dexterity saves are impaired, while attacks against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Is incapacitated, cannot move, speaks only falteringly, automatically fails certain saves, and is attacked with advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Is incapacitated and unaware, drops held items, falls prone, automatically fails certain saves, and is vulnerable to nearby attacks.
